name: Object Happy Ending
original_name: オブジェクト・ハッピーエンディング
source:
The story begins when “you,” the sole human, arrive in Objectpia—a parallel world inhabited by non-human beings with the characteristics of objects, commonly known as “Objects.”
Eager to return to your original world, you ask Punk, a young man you meet for the first time in Objectpia, to show you the way home.
The method involves fulfilling the Object’s desired way of ending their lives with your own hands—since only a human can bring an Object’s life to a close—
Interact with these unique Objects and grant them the happy endings they desire!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4642870/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事始于身为唯一人类的“你”，意外来到了“器物乡”——一个居住着兼具器物特征的非人生物（俗称“器物族”）的平行世界。
急于回到原本世界的你，向初抵器物乡时邂逅的青年“朋克”请教归乡之法。
而回去的方法，竟是亲手成全器物族所渴望的生命终结方式——因为唯有身为人类的你，能够为器物族的生命画上句号——
与这些个性十足的器物族深入交流，赐予他们所期盼的幸福结局吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4642870/_/]Steam[/url]]
